headline: US Treasury funding plans eyed by markets to lower longer-term yields
summary: Market focus shifts to the US Treasury's funding plans as expectations grow that reducing longer-term supply could boost demand and lower yields following the Federal Reserve's rate pause.
why: US Treasury debt issuance and yields serve as the benchmark for global borrowing costs, directly impacting asset valuations and fixed-income portfolios.

impacts.name: US Treasury Yields
impacts.why: Changes in longer-term debt supply and demand expectations can directly influence bond yields.
